# Not yet verified

The spec lists these as open; they are reported, never hidden:

- The refusal classification (empty, reserved\_word, no\_unit, unreadable) is bridge-side. It uses mzLib's own SdrfValidator.ReservedWords, but a TryParse overload returning the reason would move it upstream where it belongs; propose to mzLib.
- Sample order is first appearance in the document, recovered through BySourceName's own dictionary comparer because the dictionary's enumeration order is not contractual; an ordered return from mzLib would remove that step.
- since.pymzlib is null until released; Rust and R are not yet ported.
- Bulk spellings are the cross-binding decision of 2026-09-23: a separate &lt;verb&gt;\_many in every binding (R too, not vectorisation). Rust and R names here are intended, not yet ported.
